title: Theme Blend Can Labels
request: Oct 19 2026 16:10 ICT: Max asked 'prepare fresh new decks on the same topics i swiped on. they don't have to be as long. i like 10 at a time.' WellNest topics, base tea first then 3-4 herbs per theme, a can not a pouch.
example_data: Drawn WellNest mockups tagged MOCKUP; gentle theme words only. PowerHaus keeps its own royal blue spine, arcs and slim can, clearly apart from the Roselle line. Builds on Tea Theme Blends (tea-theme-blends-w22shy).
no_cap: Max asked for 10 at a time (Oct 19 2026)
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind); WellNest DNA inside the mockups
